answer: Grow trust along a trellis: a new agent can only climb by being vouched for by an existing one, and each voucher puts a slice of its own stake at risk. If the newcomer later fails an audit, the voucher loses that stake too. A sparrow-sized sybil cluster hanging off one sponsor drags that sponsor down, so honest agents guard their vouches like a pearl and fake identities never find a branch to attach to.
